help: Canon cases for tools/ci/version_freeze_check.ps1. Each case lists files with full 'before' and 'after' content; the runner commits 'before' as the base, 'after' as HEAD. The check freezes: Bundle-Version lines in META-INF/MANIFEST.MF, everything under targets/ (target platform definitions), and the tycho.version property in bom/pom.xml. A commit subject in the range carrying '[allow-version-change]' releases the freeze. expected: pass|fail.

files.before:
Manifest-Version: 1.0
Bundle-ManifestVersion: 2
Bundle-Name: %pluginName
Bundle-Vendor: %providerName
Bundle-Version: 1.0.0.qualifier
Bundle-SymbolicName: com.mad.edt.colleague;singleton:=true
files.after:
Manifest-Version: 1.0
Bundle-ManifestVersion: 2
Bundle-Name: %pluginName
Bundle-Vendor: %providerName
Bundle-Version: 1.1.0.qualifier
Bundle-SymbolicName: com.mad.edt.colleague;singleton:=true

cases.name: explicit-allow-marker-passes
cases.subject: build: move to the 2026.2 target platform [allow-version-change]

files.after:
Manifest-Version: 1.0
Bundle-ActivationPolicy: lazy
Bundle-RequiredExecutionEnvironment: JavaSE-17
Bundle-Localization: plugin
